build_and_apply_modeling_hooks: build modeling hooks from config and apply them to a PyTorch model module
create_ModelingHook_subclass: create a subclass of ModelingHook that implements apply and unapply abstract methods
apply_modeling_hooks: apply a list of ModelingHook instances to a PyTorch model in sequential order
unapply_modeling_hooks: unapply all modeling hooks from a trained model by calling model.unapply_modeling_hooks()
review_ModelingHook_apply: review the ModelingHook apply method to understand how it modifies the input model
